subject.title: fix(streaming): preserve paragraph separators across block-chunk deliveries [AI-assisted]

question: Should the permanent block-streaming contract preserve paragraph boundaries with in-band text only, explicit seam metadata through delivery, or a consciously partial common-case repair?
rationale: The source-proven bug has two open candidate PRs, but the near-`maxChars` range cannot be fully solved by naive text-only chunks without choosing a delivery contract tradeoff.

options.title: Require complete seam semantics
options.body: Pick one candidate or replacement and require it to preserve paragraph boundaries across both in-budget and near-`maxChars` splits before merge.

options.title: Adopt explicit boundary metadata
options.body: Ask the implementation to carry paragraph/newline/hard-split seam metadata through chunker, subscriber, coalescer, and outbound delivery.

options.title: Accept the partial text repair
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally land the common-case improvement while leaving the near-limit boundary documented as remaining work on the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Require complete seam semantics
recommendation.body: Pick one candidate or replacement and require it to preserve paragraph boundaries across both in-budget and near-`maxChars` splits before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history across coalescing, chunking hardening, and current-file layout near the affected surfaces.
